doc: The people of the 1871 city on Sunday 8 October, every one a reconstructed carded resident: built near the visitor at an hour their day has them out, drawn by the crowd beyond. Each person's day is `routine` (one of `routines`: the Sunday, then any other day) moved by their `shift` in hours; `home` is their household, whose house the runtime finds on the context city's street nearest `near` ([local_e, local_n]), and whose `points` (front, front_end, stroll, stroll_end) it lays on that street's walk (renderers/web/js/town-1871.js). `drives` names the car or team a driver is out with (data/transport/driven/loops.json).

provenance.basis: Everyone is a reconstructed resident bounded by the 1870 census; the name, household, trade, day, place, body and clothes are ours.
